newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 20.375 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 20.375 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates rose on Wednesday in tighter liquidity, traders said.
Overnight rates finished at 20.375 percent, up from Tuesday's 20.00 percent closing.

"Overnight rates were declining steadily since the repo rate cut and some players probably put the funds into (the central bank's) one-week or one-month reverse repo (facility)," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank.
The central bank cut four of its five repo rates by 50 basis points on Friday, bringing down the benchmark one-week reverse repo rate to 20.25 percent.
